referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA plays a minor, qualitative role (offsets from archival maps) with no processing details, so ALMA results cannot be reproduced from this paper
Cloudlet grouping and 'approximately linear' selection are subjective; number of cloudlets is small in three sources
Proper-motion uncertainties are formal linear-fit errors; systematic astrometric error is not discussed
The ellipse-centre assumption (centre = MYSO) is untested without a driving-source position

data_public_as_stated.value: ALMAGal data obtained from the ALMA archive; public status of the EVN data not stated

evidence.quote: We searched the Atacama Large Millimeter/Submillimeter Array (ALMA) Archive and found three sources with available data: G23.389$+$00.185, G23.657$-$00.127, and G31.581$+$00.077.

missing_for_reproduction: ALMA product identifiers, line transitions, imaging and measurement recipe for the ALMA part
EVN archive access and raw/calibrated data location for projects EB052, EB031, EB034, EN003
Selection criteria and thresholds for persistent cloudlets and exclusions; ellipse and plane-fit settings
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: EVN visibilities for 6 sources over 3 epochs (tens of GB); ALMAGal fields for 3 sources (tens of GB if reproduced); ALMA use is minor
reproducibility.score_reason: Proper-motion tables and numeric results are given, but the main data are EVN with unstated public access and many selection details missing; the ALMA part has no recipe at all.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA is a minor, qualitative component and the main EVN data availability and full recipe are not stated.

methods_papers.why: Describes method 1 and the ellipse-based analysis for G23.657-00.127
Cloudlet definition and best-plane fit to 3D velocities (Cepheus A HW2)
Direct least-squares ellipse fitting code used for the flux-weighted ellipses

companion_papers.why: First-epoch EVN observations (E1) and ring-like source selection
Torun single-dish monitoring of the sample

related_projects_or_surveys: EVN projects EN003, EB031, EB034, EB052
